eod.conclusion: Indian equities suffered broad declines amid global risk aversion, with both benchmark indices posting significant losses. Domestic markets mirrored international trends as surging bond yields worldwide dampened investor appetite. While regulatory developments and impending IPOs generated sector-specific interest, the overarching narrative centered on capital fleeing risk assets. Financial stocks showed relative resilience but still declined, with banking shares outperforming the broader market's steep fall.
